## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D auto-chess game with multiplayer-themed lobby, many character classes and skill combinations, monsters, and fusion classes.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (at most 1280px wide) for visual checks; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a browser-based auto-battler with a procedural Three.js arena, simulated lobby, automated combat, and responsive controls.
- Used CDN-hosted Three.js and Google Fonts; no server-side multiplayer implementation was added.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface, responsive styling, procedural 3D battlefield and units, market, reserve bench, class traits, fusion codex, monster waves, and auto-combat.
- Added recruiting, selling, deployment, leveling, unit merging, camera orbit/zoom, and help UI.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Browser QA and screenshot verification remain to be done.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli` and check for runtime errors and visible 3D gameplay.
2. Exercise core gameplay interactions and fix any issues found.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and panels.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive layout.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay logic.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The user requested a multiplayer game; the current lobby/opponents are simulated locally.
